a.lede: An online petition with over 91,000 signatures is calling for the reinstatement of Nvidia's disgraced former CEO.
a.title: Elon Musk signs petition to reinstate Jensen Huang as Nvidia CEO

b.lede: Starting Nvidia's quarterly earnings call on Tuesday, new board chair Harvey Jones said that when former CEO Jensen Huang resigned, "the Nvidia board unanimously accepted his resignation and does not intend to reinstate Jensen as CEO." Jones added, "We will not be addressing or taking questions on today's call regarding the circumstances of Jensen's resignation […]
b.title: Nvidia says it does not intend to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO
